# Changelog

## [7.0.0](https://github.com/ReactiveX/rxjs/compare/7.0.0-rc.4...7.0.0) (2021-05-11)

### Breaking Changes

* **toPromise:** `toPromise()` is deprecated, use `firstValueFrom` or `lastValueFrom`
